# Review: plan:test-load

Head: 7688c86cfa1b2bddfe67bd7404d58293ca3a61c6. Reviewer: pij-unaware-quokka.

**Verdict: PASS-WITH-NOTES.** Scope clarified by prime: remove the ad-hoc incident raises, not existing purposeful runner budgets.

## Findings and scope

No patch-introduced functional defect found in the project split, asynchronous fixture conversions or timeout injection. Two independent review slices checked exact Git objects rather than moving main.

**Scope clarification — defaults are centralized, not every timeout.** The incident raises in git-diff-action (30s suite) and unix-process-manager (three 10s tests) are removed. Exact reviewed git-cli and get-all-diffs carry no ad-hoc runner override; the competing incident raises were not retained. Existing purposeful overrides remain in 17 other files, including real-agent 180/300s budgets, mermaid's 30s hook, ODS's 10s case and bootstrap's 5s case. Prime explicitly confirmed these are outside this criterion and must stay. No repository-wide “every timeout is centralized” claim is made; test/load-bounds.ts centralizes three shared defaults.

**LOW, measurement note — bounds are conservative headroom, not empirical single-spawn guarantees.** Raw baseline `base.log:3313–3331` shows a52.452s case including multiple setup Git commands and a105.464s file. It does not measure a52.5s single spawn.120s process and60s wait are reasonable margins over that case-level observation, not a measured latency distribution.30s unit is also headroom; one cited5s ODS case deliberately waits up to5s for inheritance. The baseline sink-auth case exceeded5s, so increasing unit headroom has evidence, but scheduler starvation of every in-process delay was not instrumented.

**LOW, proof ceiling — runner deadlines do not terminate every hung child.** `test/helpers/git.ts:16–18` invokes asynchronous execFile without timeout/signal. Vitest timeout rejects a test/hook, but is not a universal child-kill/cancellation guarantee; synchronous callbacks likewise cannot be preempted by a Vitest timer. No new retry, skip, catch-all suppression or weakened assertion was introduced. A supervisor/hung-child-proof improvement would be separate scope, not a demand to add an abstraction here.

## Exact-once project inventory: proved

Main changed to d63f9250 during review. A detached exact-source snapshot `/tmp/review-test-load-7688` was created at7688c86cf; no build/install was run. Actual command:

```sh
nice -n 19 pnpm exec vitest list --filesOnly --json=/tmp/test-load/reviewer-files-7688.json
```

Compared collected canonical paths against the previous commit's tracked `test/**/*.test.ts` and `test/**/*.test.tsx`, excluding `test/e2e/**` and node_modules as in the original include/exclude contract:

| Inventory | Count |
|---|---|
| Previous include | 567 |
| Collected rows | 567 |
| Unique files | 567 |
| Process project | 64 |
| Unit project | 503 |
| Dropped / unexpected / duplicate | 0 / 0 / 0 |

Canonicalized macOS /tmp→/private/tmp before set comparison. Result retained in `/tmp/test-load/reviewer-inventory-result.json`. The deliverable's502unit/566total describes the pre-SSR full runs; exact landed7688 includes the additional SSR test, hence503/567. This is not a missing or duplicated file.

## Git fixtures/assertions: checked and exercised

`git(cwd,...args)` uses promisified execFile('git',args,{cwd}), no shell, trimmed stdout and inherited environment; rejection propagates instead of being swallowed. Converted calls await initialization/configuration/add/commit/branch/SHA reads before consumers. Integration-specific identity/signing options remain. Independent before/after review found no changed expect expression, matcher, expected value, assertion guard or test-selection condition, and no new skips.

Actual exact-source regression command used private tmux environment (TMUX/TMUX_PANE unset, TMUX_TMPDIR=/tmp/reviewer-test-load-tmux), nice19, and these9files:

- recent-feed-live-updates.integration.test.ts
- recent-feed-seed.integration.test.ts
- file-list.test.ts
- content-hash.test.ts
- get-all-diffs.test.ts
- git-branch-service.test.ts
- per-file-diff-stats.test.ts
- pr-view-entrypoints.test.ts
- git-cli.test.ts

**9files /75tests passed**,18.96s (22.36s tool wall), complete output read. Nearby recorded machine load48.14/57.17/60.37 (1/5/15min); not represented as a load270 stress run.

## Tmux default and injected path: preserved

`packages/shared/src/utils/tmux-context.ts:19–43` preserves3,000ms default on EACH display-message subprocess; the overall two-query lookup can approach6s as before. Both calls consume the argument. `getTmuxMeta(timeoutMs?:number)` forwards it; undefined activates the detector default. Production question/alert callers still supply no argument. Tests supply30s perquery via SPAWN_WAIT_MS/2. Test bounds are not imported into production.

Throwaway runtime smoke imported the exact source and used a private PATH executable named tmux (200ms query), never the real tmux server. Default detector and wrapper returned the expected session/window/pane; injected30ms detector and wrapper both returned undefined. Source review establishes the exact3,000ms numeric default; the smoke establishes actual optional forwarding/default-success paths, not a timed3s stress claim. Scaffolding removed after proof.

## Full-run acceptance evidence reused

| Run | Start→end 1-min load | Duration | Observed outcome |
|---|---|---|---|
| Baseline | 88.59→136.93 |1268s|19failed/11files; timeouts/RPC and knock-on assertions |
| Run1 |69.49→94.08|973.43s|1remaining tmux assertion; no runner/RPC timeout reported |
| FFT test step |56.05→46.14|533.99s|558files/7448tests passed;8files/63tests skipped |
| Run3 |32.84→38.79|452.16s|558files/7448tests passed;8files/63tests skipped |

`.meta` records fft and run3 exit0. These are two completed full green runs; the interrupted14:19attempt is not counted. Lower loads confound wall-time comparison: this does not prove reliability at baseline load or270, nor isolate a speedup caused solely by the refactor. The raw original logs do not pin source SHA; author identifies pre-rebase worktree and affected post-rebase test proof. Subsequent independently reviewed full FFT on pinned9ced5cb45 includes landed7688c86cf and e37b1ea0d, with559files/7453testspassed and all9tsconfigs/lint/build/audit passing; its only delta to landedf716 is timingdocs/comment. That closes the current-composition full-gate provenance gap, not the high-load measurement gap.

`fileParallelism:false` remains unchanged. Pure unit tests were already sequential; this patch does not implement optional parallelization suggested in the brief, and does not claim it does.

## Next

Keep new real-process files in PROCESS_TEST_FILES; distinguish case latency from spawn latency and shared defaults from every timeout. No application build or server restart is needed. Prime's clarified incident-raise criterion is satisfied; no functional code change is requested by this review.
